---
name: Bug
about: A command did something wrong on your machine
title: ""
---

**Command.** The exact command, and the exit code.

**Output.** Paste what it printed. Remove secrets first.

**Expected.** What you thought would happen. If `docs/SPEC.md` and the command disagree, say which one you followed.

**Environment.** Operating system, Python version (`python --version`), and Costanza version (`costanza --version`).

**Project.** Is this a fresh `costanza init`, or an existing `COSTANZA.md`? Do not attach the inbox if it contains anything private. The inbox is local on purpose.
